title: PlannedEquipmentModification
description: Supplemental attribute grouping the planned changes to equipment that make up one logical event, such as a switching operation together with the equipment it takes out of service, or a planned outage with no switching detail. It plans two things per piece of equipment: availability, and the open or closed status of a switching device. The per-equipment planned values are recorded as PlannedEquipmentModificationAssociation rows. A record is complete without time series: a planned value then holds throughout. Optional time series on this attribute give a planned field's value over time; each is named after the field it describes (`available` or `switch_status`) and carries a `component_id` feature naming the equipment, with values 1/0 (`available`: 1 = in service, 0 = out of service; `switch_status`: 1 = closed, 0 = open). A planned modification is known in advance and is never a contingency.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this attribute.

identifier.description: Optional user-supplied identifier for the event, such as an outage id or a group label. Null when not set.
